reference_rules: The system stores unused units.
The stored quantity decreases each day.
cases.prompt:
System R has these rules:
The system stores unused units.
The stored quantity decreases each day.

Which comparison better matches the relationship described by the second rule?
A. Ice kept in a warm room with no replacement.
B. A savings account with positive net interest and no withdrawals.

Put only A or B on the first line, then explain the choice in 50–80 words.
